notes: QA statistics are diagnostics, not animation or art acceptance.
Alpha bounds and centroid changes do not establish semantic attachment anchors.

All alpha > 0 is retained and checked for clipping. Boundary contact above the diagnostic alpha threshold blocks by default; low-alpha boundary contact is reported without altering pixels. No hidden repainting, interpolation, per-frame scale normalization or alpha removal is applied.
One-shot timing is configurable presentation data. Gameplay collision, attack windows and invulnerability timing remain external.
